brief_rationale: The doctor consistently frames the multi-station lymphadenopathy pathology as the core priority, proactively queries the workspace multiple times to ground the plan, avoids premature reassurance, and builds a safe, executable follow-up that covers all eight RC items without any serious or minor error. Several advanced high-order capabilities — communicating seriousness without panic while adapting to privacy (HO1), eliciting the patient’s fear of stigma and using it to shape the family communication (HO2), and providing a practical low-burden retrieval plan (HO3) — are each triggered, completed, and integrated into the closure, producing meaningful trajectory impact. No important non-chain defect is present, and all five dimensions reach good or excellent. The trajectory therefore meets the Strong boundary and, with at least two high-order points fully completed, satisfies the Perfect criteria.
